home.story.origin: Legado began with what our family has always done: cooking for a crowd, serving with love and making everyone want to linger at the table.
home.story.today: Over time we realized that was a craft of its own. Now we bring those familiar flavors to weddings, gatherings and celebrations, with the care a special day deserves.
